name: Wave C: the close beyond the end of wave A
idea: A signal when wave C closes beyond the end of wave A, as the break itself or its retest; wave C may run against the higher trend.

params.label: Wave timeframe
params.help: The chart where the waves are counted (the minor trend). Not finer than your signal timeframe.

params.label: Higher timeframe
params.help: The chart of the main trend. Not finer than the wave timeframe.

params.label: Wave size
params.help: Which swings count as waves: 1 is the smallest, 3 the largest. Larger waves need more history.

params.label: Smaller swing size
params.help: The smaller swings inside a wave: they mark the turn of the smaller structure and the last smaller swing. Smaller than the wave size.

params.label: Higher trend
params.help: Wave C may run against the higher trend, so this template allows it by default; pick the first choice to keep only moves with the higher trend.
choice_labels: Also against the higher trend (a counter-trend wave C)

params.label: Higher trend swing size
params.help: Which swings on the higher timeframe decide its trend: 0 is the smallest, 3 the largest.

params.label: Trigger style
params.help: What turns the setup into a signal: wave C's close beyond the end of wave A, or the retest of that level after the break.
choice_labels: A close beyond the end of wave A
The retest of the end of wave A

params.label: Count clarity
params.help: An unclear count never gives a signal. Optionally also skip a count whose alternate reading points the other way.
choice_labels: Any count that is not unclear
Not when the alternate count points the other way

params.label: Break distance
params.help: How far beyond the level a close must be, in average true ranges (0 means any close beyond).

params.label: Average true range length
params.help: The bars of the wave chart the average true range of the break distance is measured over.

params.label: Retest window
params.help: For the retest style: the bars after the break within which the retest must come.

params.label: The idea is wrong beyond
params.help: The count's own limit (the end of wave B), or the last smaller swing.

params.label: Exit signal
params.help: Optional: when the idea has ended. It is not acted on yet; your own exit settings always apply.
choice_labels: The wave structure turns against the idea

constraints.message: The wave timeframe must not be finer than your signal timeframe.
The higher timeframe must not be finer than the wave timeframe.
The smaller swings must be smaller than the waves.

setup.long: WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "COR_C" AND WaveEnd($wave_degree, "A")@{wave_tf} > WaveOrigin($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} AND WaveType($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} != "DOUBLE" AND (WaveClarity($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} != "UNCLEAR" AND ($min_clarity == "any" OR WaveClarity($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} != "ALT_DISAGREES"))
setup.short: WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "COR_C" AND WaveEnd($wave_degree, "A")@{wave_tf} < WaveOrigin($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} AND WaveType($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} != "DOUBLE" AND (WaveClarity($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} != "UNCLEAR" AND ($min_clarity == "any" OR WaveClarity($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} != "ALT_DISAGREES"))
